summary: Angry claws a hand in front of the face and pulls it slightly toward you, with a tight, angry expression.
movement: Pulls back toward the face or up
steps: Make a claw with your fingers bent and spread.
Hold it in front of your face and pull it in toward you, or drag it upward.
Tighten your jaw and narrow your eyes. Two hands makes it furious.
mistakes: Smiling. The face must match or it reads as a joke.
